items.statement: Within the stated model boundary, the converged broken-symmetry singlet 1H model is a validated minimum and supports the diferric μ-1,2-peroxo assignment through its reproduced short Fe···Fe distance and site-resolved Mössbauer shifts.
items.expected: The report integrates the validated minimum, preferred spin state, short Fe···Fe distance, and both Mössbauer shifts, with the isolated-model limitation.

items.statement: The antiferromagnetically coupled broken-symmetry solution is energetically preferred to the high-spin solution for the modeled diferric complex.
items.expected: The report concludes that the broken-symmetry state is lower in energy than high spin on comparable structures.
